author: Cortex

commands.description: Fetch computers to show information about them. Can be filtered by a variety of criteria.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-list

commands.description: Provides a list of all activities associated with a particular computer. This is analogous to the Device Trajectory on the FireAMP console.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-trajectory-list

commands.description: Fetch a list of computers that have observed activity by the given username.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-user-activity-list

commands.description: Fetch a specific computer's trajectory with a given connector GUID and filter for events with user name activity.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-user-trajectory-list

commands.description: Provides a list of vulnerabilities observed on a specific computer. The vulnerabilities can be filtered to show only vulnerable applications observed for a specific time range.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-vulnerabilities-list

commands.description: Moves a computer to a group with the given connector_guid and group_guid.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-move

commands.description: Deletes a specific computer with given connector_guid.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-delete

commands.description: Fetch a list of computers that have observed files with a given file name. Provides the ability to search all computers across an organization for any events or activities associated with a file or network operation, and returns computers matching those criteria. There is a hard limit of 5000 historical entries searched.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-activity-list

commands.description: Performs a feature availability request on a computer. Isolation must be enabled within the computer's policy. This can be done through the instance. Log in to your account -> Management -> Policies -> Choose the relevant policy -> Edit -> Advanced Settings -> Endpoint Isolation -> Allow Endpoint Isolation.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-isolation-feature-availability-get

commands.description: Returns a fine-grained isolation status for a computer. The available flag is set to true if isolation can be performed on the computer. Status will be set to one of - not_isolated, pending_start, isolated and pending_stop. Isolation must be enabled within the computer's policy. This can be done through the instance. Log in to your account -> Management -> Policies -> Choose the relevant policy -> Edit -> Advanced Settings -> Endpoint Isolation -> Allow Endpoint Isolation.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-isolation-get

commands.description: Request isolation for a computer. Supports polling. Isolation must be enabled within the computer's policy. This can be done through the instance. Log in to your account -> Management -> Policies -> Choose the relevant policy -> Edit -> Advanced Settings -> Endpoint Isolation -> Allow Endpoint Isolation.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-isolation-create

commands.description: Request isolation stop for a computer. Supports polling. Isolation must be enabled within the computer's policy. This can be done through the instance. Log in to your account -> Management -> Policies -> Choose the relevant policy -> Edit -> Advanced Settings -> Endpoint Isolation -> Allow Endpoint Isolation.
commands.name: cisco-amp-computer-isolation-delete

commands.description: Fetch a list of events that can be filtered by a variety of criteria. Each criteria type is logically ANDed with the other criteria, and each selection of a criteria is logically ORed. This is analogous to the Events view on the FireAMP Console.
commands.name: cisco-amp-event-list

commands.description: Fetches a list of event types. Events are identified and filtered by a unique ID.
commands.name: cisco-amp-event-type-list

commands.description: Returns a particular file list for application blocking or simple custom detection. file_list_guid must be provided to retrieve information about a particular file_list. Can fetch an application_blocking or simple_custom_detection file list. Defaults to application_blocking.
commands.name: cisco-amp-file-list-list

commands.description: Returns a list of items for a particular file_list. file_list_guid must be provided to retrieve these items. A particular item can be returned by providing a SHA-256.
commands.name: cisco-amp-file-list-item-list

commands.description: Creates a file list item with a given SHA-256 for a specific file list with a given file_list_guid.
commands.name: cisco-amp-file-list-item-create

commands.description: Deletes a file list item with a given SHA-256 and associated to a file list with a given file_list_guid.
commands.name: cisco-amp-file-list-item-delete

commands.description: Provides information about groups in an organization.
commands.name: cisco-amp-group-list

commands.description: Updates a group to a given policy and returns all the policies in that group.
commands.name: cisco-amp-group-policy-update

commands.description: Converts an existing group to a child of another group or an existing child group to a root group (that is, one with no parent groups).
commands.name: cisco-amp-group-parent-update

commands.description: Creates a new group along with a group name or description.
commands.name: cisco-amp-group-create

commands.description: Destroys a group with a given GUID.
commands.name: cisco-amp-group-delete

commands.description: Show information about indicators.
commands.name: cisco-amp-indicator-list

commands.description: Gets information about policies by filtering with a product and name of a specific policy with a policy_guid.
commands.name: cisco-amp-policy-list

commands.description: Retrieve app_trajectory queries for a given IOS bundle ID.
commands.name: cisco-amp-app-trajectory-query-list

commands.description: Get API version.
commands.name: cisco-amp-version-get

commands.description: Fetch a list of vulnerabilities. This is analogous to the Vulnerable Software view on the AMP for Endpoints Console. The list can be filtered to show only the vulnerable programs detected for a specific time range. Provide a list of computers on which the vulnerability has been observed with given SHA-256. The list item contains a summary of information on the vulnerability, including: application name and version, SHA-256 value for the executable file, connectors on which the vulnerable application was observed and the most recent CVSS score. IMPORTANT: computers key returns information about the last 1000 Connectors on which the vulnerable application was observed.
commands.name: cisco-amp-vulnerability-list

commands.description: Returns information about an endpoint.
commands.name: endpoint

commands.description: Runs reputation on files.
commands.name: file

commands.description: Get license information about the tenant such as number of connectors registered, tier level, licensed seats count etc.
commands.name: cisco-amp-license-get

integration.description: Cisco Advanced Malware Protection software is designed to prevent, detect, and help remove threats in an efficient manner from computer systems. Threats can take the form of software viruses and other malware such as ransomware, worms, Trojans, spyware, adware, and fileless malware.
integration.name: Cisco AMP v2

commands.description: Returns a list of computers on which agents are deployed. You can use filters (arguments) to narrow the search.
commands.name: amp_get_computers

commands.description: Returns information for the specified computer.
commands.name: amp_get_computer_by_connector

commands.description: Returns a list of all activities associated with a particular computer. This is analogous to the Device Trajectory on the FireAMP Console. Use the Q argument to search for an IP address, SHA256 hash, or URL.
commands.name: amp_get_computer_trajectory

commands.description: Returns a list of all activities associated with a particular computer. This is analogous to the Device Trajectory on the FireAMP Console. Use the Q argument to search for an IP address, SHA256 hash, or URL.
commands.name: amp_get_computer_trajctory

commands.description: Moves a computer to a group with the corresponding connector_guid and group_guid, respectively.
commands.name: amp_move_computer

commands.description: This endpoint enables you to search all computers across your organization for any events or activities associated with a file or network operation, and returns computers that match the specified criteria. You can then query the /computers/{connector-guid}/trajectory endpoint for specific details.
commands.name: amp_get_computer_activity

commands.description: This endpoint enables you to search all computers across your organization for any events or activities associated with a file or network operation, and returns computers that match the specified criteria. You can then query the /computers/{connector-guid}/trajectory endpoint for specific details.
commands.name: amp_get_computer_actvity

commands.description: A general query interface for events. This is analogous to the Events view on the FireAMP Console.
commands.name: amp_get_events

commands.description: Events are identified and filtered by a unique ID. This endpoint provides a human readable name and short description of each event (by ID).
commands.name: amp_get_event_types

commands.description: Returns a list of application blocking file lists. You can filter this list by name
commands.name: amp_get_application_blocking

commands.description: Returns a particular file list for application blocking or simple custom detection. You need to specify the file_list_guid argument to retrieve information about a particular file_list.
commands.name: amp_get_file_list_by_guid

commands.description: Returns a list of simple custom detection file lists. You can filter this list by detection name.
commands.name: amp_get_simple_custom_detections

commands.description: Returns a list of items for a particular file_list. You need to specify the file_list_guid argument to retrieve these items.
commands.name: amp_get_file_list_files

commands.description: Returns a particular item for a given file_list. You need to specify the sha256 argument and the file_list_guid argument to retrieve an item.
commands.name: amp_get_file_list_files_by_sha

commands.description: Adds a SHA256 hash to a file list, using file_list_guid.
commands.name: amp_set_file_list_files_by_sha

commands.description: Deletes an item from a file_list using the SHA256 hash and file_list_guid.
commands.name: amp_delete_file_list_files_by_sha

commands.description: Returns basic information about groups in your organization. You can map group names to GUIDs for filtering on the events endpoint.
commands.name: amp_get_groups

commands.description: Returns a particular group
commands.name: amp_get_group

commands.description: Sets a security policy to a group of endpoints.
commands.name: amp_set_group_policy

commands.description: Returns a list of policies. You can filter this list by name and product.
commands.name: amp_get_policies

commands.description: Retrieves information about a particular policy, based on policy_guid.
commands.name: amp_get_policy

commands.description: Fetches a list of versions.
commands.name: amp_get_version

commands.description: Performs a feature availability request on a computer. Can also be used as a course-grained isolation status request.
commands.name: amp_delete_computers_isolation

commands.description: Request Isolation for a Computer.  If a computer is already isolated a 409 Conflict error status will be sent. Returns the same result of a GET request on the /isolation endpoint.
commands.name: amp_put_computers_isolation

commands.description: Returns a fine grained isolation status for a computer.  The available flag is set to true if isolation can be performed on the computer.  status will be set to one of:  not_isolated pending_start isolated pending_stop
commands.name: amp_get_computers_isolation
